rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for manufacturing or producing something, especially a manufactured item such as a computer chip.

example.english: This factory uses advanced equipment to fabricate computer chips.
example.traditional: 呢間廠用先進設備製造電腦晶片。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 cong2 jung6 sin1 zeon3 cit3 bei6 zai3 zou6 din6 nou5 zing1 pin2

rows.note: Use this for making up something falsely, such as a lie, an excuse, or a story.

example.english: Don't fabricate things; I never said that.
example.traditional: 你唔好老作啦，我根本冇咁講過。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 lou5 zok3 laa1 ngo5 gan1 bun2 mou5 gam3 gong2 gwo3

rows.note: Use this specifically when someone invents or makes up a story, rather than for every kind of false fabrication.

example.english: They often fabricate a story about winning the Mark Six lottery.
example.traditional: 佢成日作故仔話自己中咗六合彩。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zok3 gu2 zai2 waa6 zi6 gei2 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2
